jobDescription:
Job Summary

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

Gemini - Integration Specialist

1 position

Keywords: MCP Agent-to-Agent Orchestration Enterprise Connectors Google Workspace Microsoft 365 CI/CD Python/Go

About the Role

You own how agents talk to each other and to the rest of the enterprise. On the Governance Control Tower pod, that means building and maintaining the MCP servers and orchestration protocols that let agents call tools and each other safely, wiring enterprise connectors - Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, vendor-managed MCP servers - into the retrieval layer, and making sure every integration point is wired into AssureAIs evaluation harness so nothing ships ungoverned.

What Youll Own

  • Build and operate MCP servers - not just consume them - for agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool communication.

  • Integrate enterprise connectors across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and vendor-managed MCP servers into the federated retrieval layer.

  • Own the CI/CD wiring that runs AssureAIs evaluators automatically on every agent or connector commit.

  • Maintain orchestration protocols - routing, tool use, hand-offs - for the shared top-level agent layer the GCP AI Architect designs.

  • Debug cross-agent and cross-system integration issues as the agent roster grows.

  • Partner with the AI Engineers to onboard new agents tool and connector dependencies cleanly.

What Were Looking For

  • 5+ years building integrations or orchestration for distributed/service-oriented systems, with 1-2+ years specifically on agentic AI / LLM tool-use architectures.

  • Direct experience with MCP - building servers, not only consuming them.

  • Experience with enterprise connector work (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 APIs, or comparable), including auth and entitlement-aware access.

  • Comfortable wiring automated test/evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions).

  • Proficient in Python or Go.

  • Working familiarity with Google Gemini Enterprise / ADK, or a comparable enterprise agent platform.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the Google ADK agent runtime specifically.

  • Familiarity with AssureAI or comparable evaluation tooling from the integration side, not just the eval side.

  • Prior work on API gateways (Apigee or similar) in a governed or regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like

By month two: every agents tool and connector calls route through a common, monitored MCP layer rather than one-off integrations.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary

The Cloud Engineer, focused on cloud data platforms and integration, is responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining scalable cloud-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. This role provides hands-on engineering support for Databricks, data transformation, API ingestion, and cloud-native services while following enterprise standards for security, reliability, governance, and cost efficiency. The Cloud Engineer partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to enable trusted data delivery for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational decision-making. This position reports directly to the FinOps Technical Leader and works closely with the FinOps team to support cloud and AI financial management, data engineering, automation, and reporting initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, support, and maintain cloud-based data solutions using Databricks, Azure, and AWS services.
  • Develop data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Spark, PySpark, SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • Support API-based data ingestion from internal, vendor, cloud, and enterprise platforms.
  • Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational support for cloud data pipelines and integrations.
  • Collaborate with architecture, security, FinOps, analytics, and business teams to deliver reliable and cost-effective data solutions.
  • Follow engineering standards, governance practices, and deployment processes for secure and scalable delivery.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems integration, or related technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, and data transformation or pipeline development.
  • Experience developing or consuming REST APIs for data ingestion and enterprise system integration.
  • Experience building or supporting cloud-native solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • English proficiency required, with the ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Azure services such as Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, or related services.
  • Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, RDS, CloudWatch, or related services.
  • Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, data modeling, or data governance concepts.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Git, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar reporting and data consumption platforms.
  • Understanding of cloud security practices, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, and compliance requirements.
  • Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or data engineering certifications preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience resolving data, integration, or platform issues.
  • Self-directed and proactive, with strong ownership, accountability, communication, and documentation skills.

Rockwell Automation s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

As the Support Platform Administrator, you will play a key role in ensuring the stability, configuration, and ongoing enablement of the enterprise support platform. You will be responsible for managing platform configuration, supporting operational workflows, enabling reporting, and ensuring governance as the platform scales across teams, while leveraging AI and automation capabilities to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and drive smarter support operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage users, roles, and permissions to ensure secure, compliant, and role-based access across the platform
  • Configure and maintain queues, workflows, routing logic, and macros to enable efficient and standardized ticket handling
  • Perform day-to-day platform health checks, monitor system performance, and proactively resolve configuration or workflow issues
  • Support supervisors and operations teams with dashboards and reporting capabilities, ensuring accurate and consistent data availability
  • Coordinate configuration changes, ensure proper documentation, and partner with engineering or vendors for enhancements or escalations
  • Manage API integrations, webhooks, and certificates while monitoring integration health and troubleshooting connectivity issues
  • Maintenance of our existing automation and alerting systems

  • Leverage AI and automation capabilities (e.g., workflow automation, AI-driven routing, virtual agents, Copilot integrations) to improve support efficiency and reduce manual effort
  • Identify repetitive support tasks and enable automation through workflows, APIs, or AI-driven solutions in collaboration with engineering
  • Monitor adoption and effectiveness of AI and automation features, continuously refining configurations to improve accuracy and outcomes
  • Investigate and resolve automation-related issues promptly to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted support services.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Support, Development, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, streamline workflows, and improve system performance.

jobDescription:
About Darwinbox
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1200+ global enterprises to manage their 4.5million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, JG Summit, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
Why Join Us
The way Darwinbox is evolving is unlike anything we have seen before. AI is transforming our platform, our customer experience, and the future of HR technology; this role will be at the forefront of turning that vision into reality. You will help bring our AI ambition to life in the field, working on high-impact problems with strategic customers while shaping how Darwinbox scales its next generation of intelligent products. This is the founding cohort of an entirely new function at Darwinbox the first FDEs will shape how the team operates, which customer engagements get the embedded model first, and how it scales. You will work zero layers removed from the customer and touch a stack broader than any pure product engineering role allows: the Darwinbox platform, Python at production scale, the LLM stack of your choice (Claude, GPT, Gemini), MCP servers, agent frameworks, and whatever the customer happens to run on their side.
Youll experience a culture of:
  • Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
  • Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
  • Continuous Learning and Professional Development
  • Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment
About the role
The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Darwinbox's most strategic enterprise customers to ship production-grade AI agents and Agentic Flows on the Darwinbox HCM platform inside each customer's environment. The role centres on three skill areas: production Python engineering for AI agents, deployment of LLM applications (prompt engineering at scale, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks), and architecting REST API and webhook integrations with payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, and ERP systems. You will work hands-on inside customer environments on HR workflow problems that exceed the platform's standard configuration surfaces.
What you will do
  • Embed with 23 strategic enterprise customers in parallel as the technical owner of the Darwinbox deployment in their environment.
  • Run discovery with CHROs, HRBPs, and HRIS leads to surface the real problem behind the stated ask and translate it into a working technical design.
  • Deliver a working prototype within ~1 week of engagement kick-off, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and channel field insights into the Darwinbox platform roadmap.
  • Design and ship production-grade AI agents on the Darwinbox platform for HR workflows including leave, performance, attendance, onboarding/exit automation, and HR decision support.
  • Architect custom integrations between Darwinbox and customer-side payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning platforms, and ERP stacks using REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven patterns.
  • Travel 2540 percent of the time to customer sites across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East as required.
What we are looking for
Required
  • Hands-on production Python engineering for enterprise SaaS, integrations, and AI agent development.
  • Production deployment of LLM applications: prompt engineering at scale, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
  • REST API and webhook integration design for systems interoperability (payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, ERP) with production-grade auth.
  • Customer discovery and technical translation with senior enterprise stakeholders (CHROs, HRBPs, HRIS leads).
  • Production LLM experience and willingness to travel 2540 percent candidates with only academic/demo AI exposure or hard travel constraints are unlikely to be the right fit.
Preferred
  • HCM domain knowledge across payroll, performance, attendance, talent, and recruitment workflows.
  • MCP server implementation or agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and AI observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse).
  • TypeScript or Java in addition to Python; multilingual capability across Hindi, English, or additional Indian / SEA languages.
  • Former technical founder experience, or experience in enterprise SaaS environments such as Salesforce (Agentforce), Atlassian, Databricks, Uniphore, UnifyApps, Sprinklr, Freshworks, Zoho, or similar settings with hands- on AI deployment work.
Experience and qualifications
  • 14 years of professional software engineering experience, including customer-facing (Hard requirement).
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related quantitative discipline; no certifications required.

Most entry-level writing roles move slowly. Learning takes years.

This role requires strong writing discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to learn quickly.

We care more about capability than credentials.

- your ability to learn quickly

- your writing discipline

- your commitment to becoming excellent at your work

- Developed strong expertise in professional and marketing content writing

- Built the ability to research and explain complex topics clearly

- Become proficient in using AI tools to accelerate writing workflows

- Exposure to AI-powered writing workflows

- Advanced skills in research, storytelling, and content strategy

- A foundation for a long-term career in content and communication

- Substantial financial growth positioning you to reach a point where you work by choice, not out of necessity


Many writers spend years trying to build this level of expertise.

Here, the right person can build it much faster.

We believe in investing heavily in people who take ownership of their growth.


The people who succeed here are those who treat their career like an entrepreneur treats building a business.


If you want to build an exceptional career and are willing to work for it, we would like to hear from you.

QADs products increasingly include AI agents that make and execute recommendations inside customers operations. These systems behave differently from traditional software outputs vary, quality is judgment-based rather than binary, and the cost of getting it wrong matters. Were building the function that makes AI quality measurable, defensible, and continuously improved across our portfolio, and were hiring the person to own it.

Youll design and run the evaluation framework our AI products are measured against, define the criteria that gate every release, and monitor production performance so quality issues are caught early rather than after customers feel them. The role partners closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams, and reports to the Head of Product Operations.

If youve worked on the quality and measurement side of LLM-based products and want a role where evaluation is genuinely load-bearing rather than an afterthought, this is that role.

Measure not just response quality but the quality of the decisions the AI products produce did the recommendation actually serve the customer outcome the product was built for

Treat these as leading indicators of customer issues and surface findings before they show up as support escalations. When a product regresses, you trigger a capability-tier review.

  • Define blast-radius and rollback requirements with engineering, and gate releases on thresholds in CI.

  • Practical technical skills SQL plus Python or JavaScript; comfort with evaluation/observability platforms and Git.

  • A discovery mindset toward evaluation: failure data and edge cases are the core of the job, not a postmortem activity.

  • Bias toward decision quality over surface quality. We are not optimizing for hallucination rate alone were measuring whether the AIs recommendation actually served the customers need.

descriptionFromApi:
Global EPR Lead (Extended Producer Responsibility)

Job Overview
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are expanding rapidly across global markets, creating growing compliance obligations for producers of Packaging, WEEE, and Batteries. TE Connectivity is investing in a dedicated program to stay ahead of these requirements. The EPR Lead will own and lead this program globally, working with stakeholders across the enterprise and through third-party service providers to ensure TE meets its obligations while supporting compliant market access, cost transparency, and our broader sustainability commitments.
This is a high-impact role within TE's Corporate Product & Supply Chain Compliance team. The EPR Lead will serve as TE's subject matter expert and program owner, translating complex multi-country regulatory requirements into scalable, practical compliance processes. Success in this role requires strong leadership capability and the ability to drive results through influence in a highly matrixed, global organization.
Job Requirements
EPR Program Ownership
  • Own TE's global EPR compliance program for Packaging, WEEE, and Batteries, with Packaging EPR as the immediate strategic priority given the pace of regulatory change globally.
  • Define the global strategy, governance model, and operating framework, establishing a pragmatic global baseline while managing country-specific requirements.
  • Ensure the program supports compliant product shipment, future regulatory readiness, and business scalability without linear growth in effort.
Regulatory Intelligence
  • Monitor, interpret, and communicate new and changing EPR requirements globally across EU, UK, North America, Latin America, and APAC.
  • Assess applicability by country, legal entity, product category, packaging type, and route-to-market.
  • Maintain a global obligations register, compliance calendar, and forward-looking implementation roadmap.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business units and cross-functional partners.
Third-Party & Scheme Management
  • Manage TE's network of external EPR service providers, compliance schemes, and Producer Responsibility Organizations (PROs) to fulfill registration, reporting, and scheme participation obligations across jurisdictions.
  • Define service scope, performance expectations, reporting cadence, and accountability with external partners.
  • Ensure all registrations, renewals, and scheme memberships are maintained accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate authorized representative arrangements where required.
Data Governance & Reporting
  • Define the data requirements and standards needed for EPR reporting across Packaging, WEEE, and Batteries.
  • Establish clear data ownership: Business units are accountable for ensuring accurate, complete, and timely data for their products and packaging; the EPR Lead owns the framework, standards, and reporting process.
  • Ensure reporting submissions are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain audit-ready records and supporting documentation across all jurisdictions.
Financial Stewardship
  • Forecast EPR fees and program costs by country, category, and business unit.
  • Partner with Finance on budgeting, invoice validation, and cost allocation.
  • Drive cost transparency and identify fee optimization opportunities through improved data quality, classification accuracy, and program design.
Governance & Controls
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, RACIs, and internal controls for EPR compliance.
  • Establish clear escalation paths for compliance risks, missed deadlines, or data quality issues.
  • Lead audit readiness and manage issue resolution and corrective actions.
Systems & Automation Enablement
  • Act as business lead for EPR data and process requirements across relevant systems.
  • Partner with TEIS to improve data integration and automate reporting workflows where possible.
  • Develop dashboards covering registration status, reporting deadlines, fee exposure, data completeness, and compliance risk.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, Sustainability, TEIS, business units, and India Shared Services.
  • Drive clear accountability, training, and stakeholder engagement so that EPR considerations are embedded in product, packaging, sourcing, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Provide regular updates and escalation support to senior leadership.
What your background should look like
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Finance, Sustainability Regulatory Affairs, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience working with EPR schemes, product compliance or product stewardship in a global, multi-country context. Experience from a global electronics, industrial, or manufacturing company is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Packaging, WEEE, and/or Batteries EPR obligations including registrations, reporting, and scheme participation in Europe, U.S. states, Canada and Asia.
  • Proven ability to manage third-party service providers and compliance partners effectively.
  • Strong understanding of compliance data management, governance, and process design.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership capability with proven ability to drive results through influence in a highly matrixed, global organization.
Competencies
  • Accountable - you take full ownership of EPR program health and compliance outcomes
  • Proactive - you anticipate regulatory change and drive early action across the organization
  • Collaborative - you build strong partnerships across functions, geographies, and with external parties
  • Data-Driven you use structured data and metrics to manage compliance and demonstrate results
  • Leadership you are able to influence, enable, and drive accountability without direct authority
  • Simplicity - you successfully translate regulatory complexity into practical, scalable processes
  • Global Mindset you are able to navigate regulatory differences pragmatically while maintaining a coherent global program
What Does Success Look Like?
Success in this role means that TE's EPR obligations for Packaging, WEEE, and Batteries are met on time, every time with no significant non-compliance events or missed regulatory deadlines. The right candidate will have built a well-governed program with full third-party and scheme coverage across all obligated jurisdictions, strong data completeness and accuracy driven by clear business unit accountability, and accurate fee forecasting that gives leadership confidence in EPR cost management. Beyond operational delivery, success means that EPR is embedded across TE's business decisions, regulatory changes are anticipated and acted on early, and the organization has the clarity, tools, and ownership structures needed to scale as EPR requirements continue to grow globally.

Apprentice
About the Team
Global Central Operations is a key function supporting Corporate Solutions operations across APAC. The Credit Control team plays an important role in maintaining the financial health of the portfolio by supporting timely cash allocation, follow-up of outstanding balances, reconciliation activities, query management, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Role Overview
The Apprentice will support the Credit Control team with routine operational, reconciliation, tracking, and reporting activities. This role is suitable for a fresh graduate who is eager to build foundational knowledge in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance accounting, cash management, and stakeholder communication within a structured corporate environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Support tracking of cash application, premium allocation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Assist in monitoring unpaired cash, unsettled balances, and outstanding premium items.
  • Support follow-up activities with brokers, clients, internal teams, and outsourcing partners under guidance from the team.
  • Maintain and update operational trackers such as query trackers, broker follow-up trackers, reconciliation trackers, and audit support logs.
  • Assist in preparing data for governance reviews, dashboards, KPI monitoring, and monthly reporting.
  • Support data validation, document collection, evidence preparation, and audit related activities.
  • Help with query screening, follow-ups, and coordination to ensure timely closure of open items.
  • Learn and support basic Credit Control processes including incoming payments, outgoing payments, manual pairing, and settlement follow-ups.
  • Assist in maintaining process documentation, SOP updates, and control evidence where required.
  • Participate in team meetings, process training, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Will Learn
  • Foundational understanding of Credit Control and cash management processes.
  • Exposure to insurance and reinsurance finance operations in a global environment.
  • Practical experience in reconciliation, reporting, data validation, and operational controls.
  • Understanding of stakeholder communication, follow-up discipline, and service delivery standards.
  • Experience working with internal teams, brokers, clients, and outsourcing partners.
  • Awareness of audit readiness, process documentation, and control requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • B.Com, BBA, or equivalent undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  • Basic understanding of accounting concepts and financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of MS Excel; exposure to PowerPoint and Word will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent business communication and cross-cultural skills, both verbal and written. Ability to adapt and learn in a multifaceted environment by demonstrating a strong team player skill sets.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to work with data, trackers, and reports.
  • Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and learn structured processes.
  • Good ownership mindset, learning agility, and ability to manage assigned tasks within timelines.
  • Interest in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance, credit control, or business operations.
Opportunity Summary
This apprenticeship provides a strong learning platform for fresh graduates to understand finance operations and Credit Control processes in a global corporate environment. The role is designed to build practical exposure, process discipline, stakeholder communication skills, and a foundation for future career growth in finance and operations.
Experience Level
Entry Level

JOB TITLE :: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform Engineer

JOB TYPE :: Full-time

JOB LOCATION :: India


About the Role

We re embedding AI across the entire software development lifecycle to reduce the time it takes to understand, triage, and resolve problems - from planning and code, through CI/CD, to production systems.

The AI Foundation team builds the platform infrastructure that makes AI-assisted software delivery possible inside CloudBees (and our CloudBees Unify product). Our systems ingest signals from pipelines, pull requests, source-code, tests, and incidents - and need to process them reliably, at scale, in production.

This is a platform engineering role. Your primary identity here is as someone who writes production-quality Go, operates confidently in Kubernetes-native environments, and takes observability seriously as a design constraint, not an afterthought.

You ll work in an environment where AI tooling is part of how the team operates - from development through to the systems we ship. That means being an effective conductor: knowing how to direct AI tooling, decompose problems for it, and apply the same critical judgement to its output that you would to any other contributor s work.


What You ll Do Platform Engineering
  • Design, build, and operate Go services running on Kubernetes that form the backbone of our agent infrastructure
  • Own reliability for production systems - define SLOs, write runbooks, and be accountable when things go wrong
  • Instrument everything: structured logging, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and metrics that surface both system health and the behaviour of the AI workflows running on top
  • Contribute to Kubernetes-native patterns: operators, CRDs, workload isolation, and resource management for dynamic agent workloads
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support rapid, safe iteration - using AI tooling as a natural part of that workflow
Engineering in an AI-Native Environment
  • Use AI development tooling effectively - generating, reviewing, and steering code with the same rigour you d apply to any PR
  • Decompose and delegate work to AI agents where appropriate, and know when not to - catching drift, validating output, and maintaining ownership of outcomes
  • Review AI-generated code with an understanding of its specific failure modes: plausible-looking but subtly wrong logic, missing edge cases, and over-confident implementations
  • Contribute to the team s shared judgement on when new models, frameworks, or tooling change the architecture assumptions we re building on
Technical Collaboration
  • Partner with the broader AI Foundation team to establish platform patterns that other teams adopt
  • Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to build vs buy decisions
  • Mentor more junior engineers and raise the team s bar for production readiness and operational discipline
Working Across Disciplines
  • Youll work closely with ML engineers and agentic systems engineers on the team, providing the platform foundation - reliability, observability, deployment infrastructure - that lets their work reach production safely.
  • This is a genuine collaboration: youll bring rigour to how their systems are built and operated, and theyll bring you along on the AI domain specifics - model behaviour, context design, evaluation approaches - as the work demands.
  • You wont be expected to arrive knowing that space deeply; you will be expected to engage with it seriously.
What We re Looking For


Required
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time operating at senior level
  • Strong Go - idiomatic, well-tested, production-shipped (if you meet all the other requirements, but have a different language - please apply)
  • Solid Kubernetes operations experience: you ve debugged real production incidents, understand the scheduler, and know when a CRD is the wrong answer
  • Hands-on observability experience - OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, distributed tracing - and a genuine conviction that unobservable systems are untrustworthy
  • Cloud-native background on AWS or GCP: IAM, managed Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code
  • Comfortable working in an AI-augmented development environment - directing tools, critically evaluating their output, and maintaining engineering rigour throughout
  • Demonstrated ability to own production systems end-to-end: design, ship, monitor, iterate
Preferred

About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India s most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.

About the Role

As a core member of the AI Research team youll turn cutting-edge, vision-language and diffusion advances into robust real-time systems that see reason and act on dynamic construction sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research & innovate diffusion-based generative models for photorealistic wall-surface simulation, defect synthesis and domain adaptation.
  • Architect and train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language Action Models (VLA) objectives that connect textual work orders, CAD plans and sensor data to pixel-level understanding.
  • Lead development of auto-annotation pipelines (active learning, self-training, synthetic data) that scale to millions of frames and point-clouds with minimal human effort.
  • Optimize and compress models (INT8, LoRA, distillation) for deployment on Jetson-class edge devices under ROS 2.
  • Own the full lifecycle problem definition, literature review, prototyping, offline/online evaluation and production hand-off to perception & controls teams.
  • Publish internal tech reports and external conference papers; mentor interns and junior engineers.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years in deep-learning R&D or Ph.D./M.S. in CS, EE, Robotics or related field with strong publication record.
  • Demonstrated expertise in diffusion models (DDPM, LDM, ControlNet) and multimodal transformers / VLMs (CLIP, BLIP-2, LLaVA, Flamingo).
  • Proven success building large-scale data-centric AI workflows active learning, pseudo-labeling, weak supervision.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, PyTorch (or JAX), experiment tracking and scalable training (PyTorch Lightning, DeepSpeed, Ray).
  • Familiarity with edge-AI runtimes (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime), and CUDA / C++ performance tuning.
  • Strong mathematical foundation (probability, information theory, optimization) and ability to translate theory into production code.
  • Bonus: experience with synthetic data generation in Isaac Sim or robotics perception stacks (ROS2, Nav2, MoveIt 2, Open3D)
